decision.explanation: Both answers are supported by distinct documents referring to different 'Museums of Applied Arts'. Document D1S2 states that the Museum of Applied Arts (likely in Germany) was founded in 1874 as the Kunstgewerbemuseum. Document D2S4 and D3S3 refer to the Museum of Applied Arts in Budapest, Hungary, which was built between 1893 and 1896. These are separate institutions with the same name, and both dates are valid in their respective contexts.
